explanation: The adapter retrieves patients from the REST API endpoint '/patients' and converts each record into a FHIR Patient resource. It maps patient identifiers, transforms names and sex codes ('F'/'M' to 'female'/'male'), and reformats birth dates from 'DD/MM/YYYY' to ISO 8601 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Any record missing required fields or failing format checks is safely rejected and reported through log() with field information only.
suggested_tests: Test successful extraction with a valid patient record having DD/MM/YYYY birthDate and 'F' sex code.
Test rejection when patient_id contains invalid characters such as special punctuation.
Test rejection when date_of_birth is improperly formatted or an invalid calendar date.
Test rejection when sex is missing or not recognized in the code mapping table.
